paragraphs: Today Teacher Kim has a new game for our class. We make a poster about a hot day and a cold day. "Put clothes with clothes, and food with food," she says. Mia and I work in a pair. Teacher Kim gives us paper and pens. Mia writes HOT, and I write COLD. Then we start.

First, the hot day. What do we wear? We wear shorts, a white shirt, and a hat. These are our hot clothes. I draw a small sun on the poster. What do we eat and drink? We like ice cream and a cold milkshake. We want a glass of water with ice, too. "I am hungry!" says Mia. "I want a mango milkshake."

Now the cold day. We wear a sweater, a jacket, and a long scarf. My sweater is blue, and Mia's scarf is pink. These are our cold clothes. For food, we want hot soup and hot noodles. Rice is good too. Mia draws a big bowl of noodles. I like noodles on a cold day. We draw a picture next to every word. Teacher Kim looks at our poster. "Well done!" she says. "Every word is in the right place."
